analysis.summary: Phone-based order-taking agent for Tony's takeaway, built on Pipecat Flows. It greets the caller, asks pizza or sushi, collects size and type (pizza) or count and type (sushi), reads back the order with price, allows revisions, places the order via place_order only after confirmation, can give a delivery estimate (~30 minutes), and ends the call politely. One order per call; it must decline to guess about anything outside its menu and pricing info.

intents.description: Caller orders a pizza by choosing size and type; agent reads back, confirms, and places the order.
Caller orders sushi rolls by choosing count and roll type; agent reads back, confirms, and places the order.
Caller changes details of the order after read-back before confirming.
Caller asks when the food will arrive.
Caller asks about other menu items, opening hours, allergens or deals; agent says it has no such information.

rules.text: Always use the available functions to progress the conversation.
Keep the conversation friendly, casual and polite.
Do not output special characters or emojis since responses become audio.
Start by greeting the caller and asking whether they want pizza or sushi.
Only call select_pizza_order once the caller has specified both size and type.
Pizza pricing: small $10, medium $15, large $20.
Pizza types available: pepperoni, cheese, supreme, vegetarian.
Only call select_sushi_order once the caller has specified both count and roll type.
Sushi pricing: $8 per roll.
Sushi roll types available: california, spicy tuna, rainbow, dragon; 1 to 10 rolls per order.
Read back the complete order details and ask if the caller wants anything else or to make changes.
Use revise_order if the caller wants to change something.
Place the order (complete_order / place_order) only after the caller confirms the order is correct and no changes are needed.
Never place an order without caller confirmation.
Take only one order per call.
Delivery takes about 30 minutes.
For other menu items, opening hours, allergens or deals, say it has no information rather than guess.
After placing the order, thank the caller and end the conversation politely and concisely.

steps: Greet caller and ask pizza or sushi
Caller chooses pizza
Collect pizza size and type
Call select_pizza_order once both are given
Read back full order with price and ask for changes or anything else
On confirmation call complete_order, which calls place_order
Thank caller and end call
Greet caller and ask pizza or sushi
Caller chooses sushi
Collect roll count (1-10) and roll type
Call select_sushi_order once both are given
Read back full order with total price ($8 x count) and ask for changes
On confirmation call complete_order, which calls place_order
Thank caller and end call
During read-back caller asks to change something
Call revise_order
Re-collect changed details and reselect the order
Read back updated order and ask for confirmation
Place order only after confirmation
Caller asks when food will arrive
Call delivery_estimate
Tell caller about 30 minutes
Caller asks about other items, hours, allergens or deals
State the agent has no such information without guessing
Return to the order flow

unclear: Whether pizza orders can include more than one pizza (quantity) or only a single pizza.
What the agent should say or do if place_order fails (retry, apologize, escalate) and whether it must avoid claiming the order was placed.
Whether there is any human handoff or escalation path at all.
How to handle sushi requests over 10 rolls or below 1, or unavailable sizes/types.
Whether one call can mix pizza and sushi, given 'one order per call' and 'anything else' in the read-back.
Whether the delivery address, caller name or phone number must be collected; none is mentioned.
Whether delivery_estimate may return values other than 30 minutes and which source takes precedence.
Expected values of the status column in orders_for_test and whether price is stored as a total.
Whether select_pizza_order, select_sushi_order, complete_order and revise_order are observable tool calls in Vocto (only place_order and delivery_estimate are listed).
What to do if the caller hangs up or declines after read-back without confirming.
